notes.title: Nextfest Streaming Event
notes.content:
KEB UP: The Journey to the Top Begins!

Step into the world of KEB UP, where you’ll take on the role of an apprentice determined to become the ultimate kebab master! In this relaxing yet challenging parkour adventure, you'll climb to new heights, exploring various cities around the world in search of the secret of kebab mastery.

What to expect in this event:

Challenging but calming parkour levels designed for all skill levels
Unique skewer mechanics to help you climb faster and overcome obstacles
Beautiful, original music to enhance your gameplay experience
A chance to open kebab shops in different cities as you progress
Special event quests and unlockable achievements
Let the soothing music and immersive gameplay carry you through your journey as you master the art of kebab in different locations. Can you reach the top and become a legendary kebab master?

Don't miss out on the fun!
